iti55:1.1: (Tik. I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti55:2.1: Tisso imā bhikkhave esanā. Katamā tisso? Kāmesanā bhavesanā brahmacariyesanā, imā kho bhikkhave tisso esanā ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti55:3.1: Kāmesanā bhavesanā brahmacariyesanā saha | itisaccaparāmāso diṭṭhiṭṭhānā samussayā ||
iti55:4.1: Sabbarāgavirattassa taṇhakkhayavimuttino | esanā paṭinissaṭṭhā diṭṭhiṭṭhānā samūhatā | esanānaṃ khayā bhikkhu nirāso akathaṃkathī ti ||
iti55:5.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||6||
